decks.notes: This deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo as quickly as possible while disrupting the opponent's game plan with discard and removal spells. The deck utilizes cards like Grisly Salvage and Vessel of Nascency to find key pieces, while also including cards like Witherbloom Command and Liliana of the Veil to control the board. Once the combo is assembled, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and flying threats like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Parhelion II.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and using effects like Mayhem Devil's triggers, the deck can chip away at the opponent's life total while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional flexibility and ramp. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughseize and removal in Fatal Push to keep the opponent on the back foot. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient aggro tactics and sacrifice value.

The deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice mechanics and aggressive playstyle to overwhelm opponents. It makes use of cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, Claim the Firstborn, and Witch's Oven to constantly pressure and disrupt the opponent's board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. The deck also features removal and disruption spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the game. Overall, the deck aims to maintain board presence, generate value from sacrificing creatures, and ultimately outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures and burn spells to deal damage to the opponent as fast as possible. The deck also includes cards like Chained to the Rocks for removal and Showdown of the Skalds for card advantage and buffs. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless assault, using cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage to chip away at their life total while maintaining board presence with cards like Pia Nalaar and Runaway Steam-Kin.

This deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures to trigger abilities like Mayhem Devil's ping damage, while using Claim the Firstborn to steal opponents' creatures and Cauldron Familiar for repeated triggers. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion for additional mana flexibility. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and clear the way for attacking with Bloodtithe Harvester. The mana base consists of lands that allow for both colors, with some utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Den of the Bugbear for additional value.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize green devotion cards to generate a lot of mana and ramp into powerful threats quickly. The deck focuses on playing mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, along with enchantments like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven, to increase green devotion. This allows for explosive plays with cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner, Karn, the Great Creator, and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Old-Growth Troll and Lair of the Hydra to quickly close out games.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger effects and deal damage to the opponent while using Jegantha as a companion. The key strategy is to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, then combo off with cards like Mayhem Devil, Witch's Oven, and Cauldron Familiar to deal incremental damage. The deck also includes various lands that can provide additional utility or mana fixing. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and create a difficult board state for the opponent to deal with.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the card Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Worldspine Wurm and Xenagos, God of Revels onto the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Make Disappear to create tokens and generate extra value. The inclusion of counter spells like Negate and Spell Pierce helps protect the combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its approach to generating powerful board states and overwhelming the opponent with big threats.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana through devotion to green cards such as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Elvish Mystic, allowing for powerful plays with high-cost green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The deck also utilizes cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures provides additional utility and protection. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and efficient mana production.

The main concept of this deck revolves around quickly generating mana through devotion to green with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Elvish Mystic. This allows for powerful plays with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck aims to ramp up quickly and overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats like Old-Growth Troll and Polukranos Reborn. Additionally, the deck includes ways to protect its key pieces and manipulate the top of the deck with cards like Oath of Nissa and Storm the Festival.

The deck focuses on using cards like Indomitable Creativity, Transmogrify, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to cheat powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier or Volcanic Spite onto the battlefield quickly. It also includes counterspells like Spell Pierce and Negate for protection, along with cards like Secrets of the Key and Prismari Command for card advantage and versatility. The goal is to create a strategic and versatile combo deck that can win through explosive creature plays and control elements.

Utilizing mana acceleration with green devotion creatures and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, this deck aims to play big threats early and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures and planeswalkers. The deck includes cards that ramp, fix mana, and generate card advantage to consistently apply pressure and maintain board presence. Additionally, it includes a toolbox of artifacts to synergize with Karn, the Great Creator's ability to search for silver bullets to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This Pioneer 1 vs 1 Aggro-Spirit deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with low-cost Spirit creatures like Rattlechains, Mausoleum Wanderer, and Spectral Sailor. The deck utilizes disruptive elements such as Spell Queller and Supreme Phantom to control the game and prevent opponents from executing their strategies effectively. Curious Obsession provides card draw to maintain momentum, while Shacklegeist offers removal options. The deck includes a mix of land and creature types to provide flexibility in play. Additional support cards like Lofty Denial and Geistlight Snare help protect the board and disrupt opponent's plans.

This aggressive Rakdos deck focuses on disruption and direct damage to quickly overwhelm opponents. Using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act, alongside hand disruption from Thoughtseize, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot. Creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester provide additional pressure, while powerful finishers such as Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can secure the win. The deck also includes utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Hive of the Eye Tyrant to give it an edge in the late game.

This deck focuses on using sacrifice effects to control the board and deal damage to the opponent while generating value from cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar. It also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Claim the Firstborn to disrupt the opponent's game plan and steal their creatures. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells and it includes a companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional value. Overall, the strategy relies on efficient removal, creature theft, and constant pressure to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize Lotus Field as a powerful mana engine to ramp into big spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum quickly. The deck focuses on generating large amounts of mana through cards like Hidden Strings and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to cast game-ending threats or card advantage spells. It also includes a mix of interaction and card selection to help find key pieces of the combo and disrupt opponent's strategies. This combo-centric strategy aims to bring the game to a swift conclusion by overwhelming the opponent with powerful plays.
